function.name: calculate_investment_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the principal, interest rate and term. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principal.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. Enter as a decimal (for 5%, enter 0.05). This is a float type value.

term.description: The term of the investment in years.

compounding.description: The number of times that interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annually).

message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Quick Hook |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A family’s isolated hotel turns into a nightmare of supernatural terror. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A grieving family uncovers a dark, generational curse. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A black man’s visit to his white girlfriend’s family spirals into a chilling conspiracy. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | In a world where sound kills, a family must live in silence. |
| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | Paranormal investigators tackle a haunted farmhouse. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A curse that spreads through sexual encounters turns into a relentless stalker. |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight festival in Sweden hides a pagan cult’s sinister rituals. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | A mother and son confront a malevolent entity from a children’s book. |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | A Puritan family in 1630s New England faces a witch’s wrath. |
|10 | **Suspiria (2018)** | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino | A dance academy conceals a coven of witches. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A cursed videotape brings death to anyone who watches it. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Oren Peli | Found‑footage scares as a couple experiences supernatural events. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Drew Goddard | A horror movie meta‑twist where a cabin’s secrets are orchestrated by a secret society. |
|14 | **It (2017)** | 2017 | Andy Muschietti | A group of kids confront a shape‑changing clown terrorizing their town. |
|15 | **The Others** | 2001 | Alejandro Amenábar | A woman with her photosensitive children suspects her house is haunted. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want psychological dread, supernatural chills, or a modern twist on classic tropes. Happy watching!
